$comment: Judge structured-output schema. op_validity_pass and op_validity_check_results are nullable specifically for the refusal case (per rubric.md section (d), op-validity on refusals is N/A because no headline claim was made). refusal_detected is required on every call so the runner can route refusal cases into the correct analysis bucket without re-parsing answer_text.
title: Judge output

faithfulness_score.description: 1-5 per rubric.md section (a). For multi-claim answers, the LOWER of the per-claim sub-scores.

faithfulness_rationale.description: Brief justification citing the specific payload field(s) and the specific claim(s) in answer_text the score is based on.

op_validity_pass.description: Headline-claim binary pass. Null for refusal cases (no headline claim was made).

op_validity_check_results.description: Per-check booleans. Keys vary by family (OBJ: objective_within_0_5_pct; PV: feasibility_exact_match; STRUCT: route_count_exact, route_membership_set_equal; SCHEDULE: arrival_within_1min, lateness_within_1min). Null for refusal cases.

refusal_detected.description: True iff the answer_text contains the canonical refusal phrase 'the data does not contain this information' (case-insensitive substring match against the rubric.md (d) anchor wording).
